name: Promptverse
description:
1. Synthesizes brand intelligence from plans and supporting documents to create a dynamic battle narrative,
2. Then processed through the Prompt Mix Engine to generate context-aware, brand-specific prompt mixes
3. Using the prompt mix numbers as a base to generate actual prompts for the defined audience
remarks: Demo Completed with Sharan and Feedback Incorporated

name: Misinformation Agent
description: Checks every AI answer against the narrative the brand wants to own and flags where it is stated wrongly, weakly or left out, with a risk score and source.

name: Web Audit Intelligence Agent
description:
1. Scores any digital property against a standard technical readiness checklist (crawlability, robots.txt, llms.txt, schema, metadata, canonical) before build,
2. Inspects how owned sites are actually configured for AI (robots.txt, llms.txt, schema, metadata, headings, canonical structure) and returns a pass or fail fix list,
3. Reads server and CDN logs to show which AI crawlers actually arrived, how often they returned, and whether the visit was to cite, index or train.

name: Open Evidence Analysis
description: Analyzes how Open Evidence represents the brand, competitors and category to expose accuracy and citation gaps in AI-cited clinical evidence.

name: ROI Agent
description: Quantifies the ROI of investing in GEO across all stages of a brand's lifecycle. Helps pharma brands measure incremental visibility, engagement, and business impact while identifying opportunities to sustain relevance and drive growth.

name: GEO in Media
description: Defines how paid/media planning and placements are structured so AI engines pick up and cite brand messaging, not just human impressions.
remarks: New pure-play PoV, to be conceptualized

name: GEO in Medical
description: Optimizes scientific publications, journal articles and congress abstracts so AI engines retrieve and cite them as evidence.
remarks: Have been divided into multiple smaller chunks by Ayushi and Vijay, they will not work one by one on each component

name: GEO in Email
description: Structures owned email/CRM content and approved claims so they reinforce the narrative AI surfaces elsewhere.

name: GEO for EU5
description: Adapts GEO for France, Germany, Italy, Spain and UK — accounting for local-language AI answers, market-specific engines/sources, and regulatory/claim differences per market.

name: GEO for Pre-Commercial
description: Adapts GEO for the pre-commercial phase, shaping disease-state and scientific narratives so AI engines surface accurate category and evidence context ahead of brand launch.
remarks: Will be made when GEO in Publication will be completed, That will provide us in depth POV

name: Citation Outreach Agent
description: Traces which sources each engine cites, ranks fixes by medical risk, and builds the outreach list of publications where evidence must land.

name: GEO Owned-Site & On-Page Optimization Playbook
description: Playbook to optimize brand-owned properties (site, docs, schema) so AI engines can find, read and cite them.

name: GEO Citation & Third-Party Authority Playbook
description: Playbook to influence third-party and earned sources AI engines cite most, so the brand shows up where it does not own the page.

name: GEO Clinical Evidence Playbook
description: Playbook to strengthen the clinical and scientific evidence AI relies on for medical answers.

name: GEO Paid & Sponsored Visibility Playbook
description: Playbook to be created for optimizing paid channels for AI visibility.

name: Technical GEO
description: Technical GEO ensures digital properties are structured for AI crawlability, retrieval, interpretation, and citation across AI-powered search experiences.
remarks: Will work with Mohit to finalize and send across next week
notes: Uplift, templatize and publish as GEO checklist, what level of access required to validate this checklist.

name: Draft Outreach Email Agent
description: Turns each citation-outreach target into a ready-to-send, personalized email pitch to the publication or author, with the brand's proof points built in.

name: Executive KPI Agent
description: Pulls visibility, share of answer, citation share and accuracy into one view, explains what moved, and recommends the next actions.
remarks: Will be picked post completion of Misinformation Agent

name: Knowledge Graph
description: Build a therapy-area-first knowledge graph that connects diseases, patient populations, brands, evidence, claims, safety, content, and AI visibility into a unified intelligence layer. Enable GraphRAG-powered retrieval, narrative mapping, citation tracking, and GEO visibility measurement across AI platforms for scalable brand intelligence and decision support.

name: GEO OS Bluesky Thinking Workshop
description: Workshop to gather ideas from team for product development and create a product backlog

name: Prompt Tagging Taxonomy
description: Description on how to tag prompts under right bucket of Visibility, Sentiment and Factcheck

name: GEO Best Practices for Web
description: Describes what GEO Good practices should be followed for Web

name: GEO Best Practices for Video
description: Describes what GEO Good practices should be followed for Web
